answer: The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in signal, expire in comet, and quill lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 157 aliases hence needs 44 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3074 identities would post 2222 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
